name: Daniel Gade
summary: Daniel MacArthur Gade (born February 7, 1975) is an American critic of United States veterans' services and disability policies, a former political candidate, a professor and researcher, and a United States government contractor. In 2005, Gade became an amputee after receiving wounds while serving as a company commander in Ramadi, Iraq. In 2017, Gade retired from the United States Army as a Lieutenant Colonel.
